subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: Most Volume Booster users kill their battery in one tap. Here's the fix.
body_paragraphs: You got Volume Booster Pro because you wanted the boost without the ads. Clean. Fast. Out of your way. But here's what most users get wrong: they leave the slider at +200% on every source. It drains your battery, distorts low-quality audio, and makes podcasts sound like a tin can. I've seen it happen a hundred times.

The fix is boring but effective: match the boost to the content. Podcasts at +50%. Music at +100%. Movies at +150%. Only crank +200% when you're in a noisy room or using cheap earbuds. Your phone's speaker will last longer. Your ears will thank you.

Inside the app, there's a hidden EQ preset that does this automatically. Tap the 'Auto' mode. It reads the audio source and adjusts the slider. No thinking. No tweaking. Just clean volume, every time.
Open the app now and switch to Auto mode. That one tap changes everything. P.S. The battery life bump alone is worth it — most users miss this for weeks.
